Original readingTime truly counts and calculates. Platform uses its documented wordBound option with ASCII whitespace plus listed common Chinese punctuation to support normal quotes/brackets; ASCII punctuation within a non-space fragment is still counted as part of that fragment, including a punctuation-only fragment. Chinese BMP Han per-character, not language tokenization. Native charCodeAt doesn't implement supplementary CJK; platform rejects emoji/extension Han/Katakana/fullwidth alphanumeric rather than claim Unicode accuracy. <=20000UTF16/64KiB text, speed100–1000 integer assumed count-units/min, realWorker2s. Original display text may round tiny value to0min; UI shows original milliseconds/1000 and records upstream display separately. No ability/speed diagnosis or scientific reading measurement, no HTML parsing/URL scraping/API/upload.
